text:
An army of vanaras was building Ram Setu, boulder by boulder.

At the edge of the shore, a tiny squirrel carried one pebble at a time.

The others laughed. What difference could something so small make?

But Rama saw what they missed.

The squirrel kept showing up, whether the tide was calm or rough. And with every return, another gap was filled.

Investing can work the same way. You do not need to predict the perfect market moment. A S. I. P. lets you invest the same amount regularly, through the ups and downs.

Small steps, repeated consistently, can build something bigger.

Start your S. I. P. with Zeb Pay.
instruction: A mature Indian English male narrator, around forty-five, with a deep resonant baritone and a neutral educated Indian accent. Reverent and grounded like a premium epic-mythology documentary, measured medium-slow pace, warm authority, restrained emotion, clean close-mic studio sound, precise consonants, and natural pauses. Clearly pronounce every initial in S. I. P. separately. Pronounce vanaras, Ram Setu, Rama, and Zeb Pay naturally. Avoid theatrical booming, caricature, sales-announcer energy, and imitation of any real person.
